rankings.article: Master Peyton stays No. 1 with the strongest Week 4 starter projection in the league at about 146 points. The starting lineup and bench remain elite, while one starter currently has limited projection coverage. A tougher matchup with Blaze Infantry is not enough to knock the league leader from the top spot.

The Don’s Soldiers holds No. 2 with a 137.7-point Week 4 starter projection and an A-grade lineup. The roster still carries useful depth and strong projection coverage. A favorable matchup with bonebuster gives this team one of the better Week 4 spots.

Kaaron Rodgers remains No. 3 with a 138.7-point Week 4 starter projection and one of the stronger depth profiles in the EFL. There is some current availability risk in the starting group, which trims the health grade. The Duke provides a meaningful opponent test, so Kaaron needs its high-end lineup to keep carrying the load.

The Duke holds No. 4 with a balanced lineup projected around 123.8 points this week. Depth remains solid and the primary starters have strong Week 4 projection coverage. A matchup with No. 3 Kaaron Rodgers keeps Duke just outside the top three.

Blaze Infantry stays No. 5 with a Week 4 starter projection around 115.9 points and B-level lineup and depth strength. Some current availability uncertainty lowers the health grade slightly. Drawing No. 1 Master Peyton is the toughest opponent adjustment on the slate.

Mach Chicken climbs to No. 6 with a Week 4 lineup projected around 113.7 points. Projection coverage is complete and the bench remains solid enough to absorb normal weekly volatility. A favorable matchup with LandsharkSC helps Mach edge ahead of Trash Pandas.

Trash Pandas slips to No. 7 despite a 117.6-point Week 4 starter projection and one of the better benches in the league. Multiple current availability questions and incomplete projection coverage pull the health grade down. The matchup with KamaraVirus125177 is favorable, but the roster needs more certainty to move back up.

LandsharkSC remains No. 8 with a Week 4 group projected around 106.6 points. The current lineup has clean projection coverage, but a thinner bench leaves less margin for error than the teams above it. Mach Chicken is manageable, though Landshark still needs more starting-lineup ceiling to climb.

BigKipper74 holds No. 9 with a lineup projected around 93.5 points in Week 4. The roster has solid projection coverage but still lacks the starting ceiling and depth of the upper half. A favorable matchup with 28Wizardking keeps BigKipper within reach of the middle tier.

28Wizardking stays No. 10 with a Week 4 projection around 100.1 points. The starters have complete projection coverage, but the C- depth grade still leaves little protection if the lineup underperforms. BigKipper74 is a favorable opponent on paper and gives Wizard a chance to outperform the ranking.

KamaraVirus125177 moves up to No. 11 with a Week 4 lineup projected around 97.7 points. Projection coverage is clean, though the starting strength and depth still trail most of the league. Trash Pandas has more availability uncertainty this week, improving Kamara's matchup outlook.

bonebuster falls to No. 12 with a league-low Week 4 starter projection around 86.9 points. The roster still carries some weekly upside, but availability uncertainty and a low recent-form grade keep the floor fragile. Facing No. 2 The Don’s Soldiers makes this the hardest path upward on the Week 4 board.
